record.reason: This paper analyzes how model growth, recursion and boundary operators change pretraining scaling exponents. The text situates looping as inference-time compute scaling and parameter efficiency, but its experiments concern scaling behavior during training rather than a serving intervention or measured inference resource improvement. The relation to inference-scale surveys is indirect.
record.title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents
